entities.name: EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message
entities.description: Authentication challenge message sent by network to UE containing 5G authentication challenge data and ABBA parameter.

entities.name: EAP-response/AKA'-challenge message
entities.description: Authentication response message sent by UE to network containing authentication response (RES) and optionally AT_RESULT_IND attribute.

entities.name: USIM
entities.description: Universal Subscriber Identity Module that derives CK, IK and computes authentication response (RES) using 5G authentication challenge data.

entities.name: ME
entities.description: Mobile Equipment that derives keys, generates security contexts, and handles authentication procedures.

entities.name: SNPN access operation mode
entities.description: Condition where UE operates in Standalone Non-Public Network access mode with specific credential indications.

entities.name: Indication to use MSK for KAUSF derivation
entities.description: Condition where USIM credentials contain indication to use MSK instead of EMSK for KAUSF derivation after successful authentication.

entities.name: Partial native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context created in ME volatile memory identified by ngKSI value, containing KAMF and other security parameters.

entities.name: AT_RESULT_IND attribute
entities.description: Optional attribute that may be included in EAP-response/AKA'-challenge message as specified in RFC 5448.

relations.description: EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message triggers USIM to derive CK, IK and compute RES
USIM passes RES to ME for further processing
SNPN access operation mode guards the condition for using MSK instead of EMSK
ME creates partial native 5G NAS security context in volatile memory when new KAUSF is generated
EAP-response/AKA'-challenge message may contain AT_RESULT_IND attribute
Presence of AT_RESULT_IND in EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message guards UE's inclusion of AT_RESULT_IND in response
